architecture: Masked source region + local context + geometry; shared MLP 528-128-64 with separate role/type heads
framework: NumPy CPU; SVG/PDF masks supply geometry, not a trained mask decoder

validation.reference: Held-out frozen labels: mostly automatic proposals plus any explicit human reviews.

humanValidation.reference: Human-reviewed held-out labels; raw model output without reviewed overrides.
humanValidation.limitation: A small positive-only review set measures recognition of these examples, not corpus-wide precision.

decoder.rule: Score each learned type together with its compatible role: role score × type score. Roles without learned types use the role score alone. Choose the largest score across all candidates.
decoder.score: Unnormalized agreement score, not calibrated accuracy. No rescaling within a prematurely selected role.
decoder.margin: Winning candidate score minus the next candidate score.

hardExampleMining.policy: Train pages only; frozen targets and weights retained. Existing model selects difficult examples, never supplies replacement labels.

rareTypePolicy.weakOnlyTypeBudget: Supplement eligible quality >= 0.2 examples up to each round per-type budget; held-out type coverage capped at 350.
rareTypePolicy.note: Training examples only. Repetition is not new evidence. Human training labels are always included.

scopePolicy: Exterior ink is excluded from fitting, normalization, validation, test sampling and transcript refinement.
metricWarning: All automatic-label metrics are teacher agreement or transcript consistency, not measured human-ground-truth segmentation accuracy.
trainingRule: Frozen independent training-label dataset; automatic and reviewed provenance retained. Rounds never replace targets with own predictions.
testPolicy: No test pages in fitting, normalization, pseudo-label sampling, early stopping, or round selection.
